1453-4694-5231-7306.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
1453-4694-5231-7306.description:
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, adding {R}.
When that creature dies, The Ooze triggers, creating a Mutagen artifact token for each +1/+1 counter on the sacrificed creature. These artifacts are also 0/0 creatures due to March of the Machines.
Each Mutagen artifact creature token enters with at least one +1/+1 counter on it due to Arwen.
Repeat from step 1.

772-3175-8095.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing Sun Titan.
When Sun Titan dies, Shade's Form triggers, returning Sun Titan from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Sun Titan enters, it triggers, returning Shade's Form from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to Sun Titan.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability.
Repeat.

2457-2757-4772.description:
Activate Ant Queen by paying {1}{G}, creating two creature tokens due to Doubling Season.
Activate Earthcraft by tapping a creature token, untapping a basic Forest.
Activate the Forest by tapping it, adding {G}.
Repeat steps 2 and 3 one additional time.
Repeat from step 1.

104-5641-6890-7810.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
104-5641-6890-7810.description:
Gain life.
Cleric Class triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Basking Broodscale.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a creature token and an artifact token.
When the artifact token enters the battlefield, Arbaaz Mir triggers, causing you to gain 1 life and dealing 1 damage to each opponent
Repeat from step 2.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-3007-3899-4552-7704.easyPrerequisites: You have a card in hand.
539-3007-3899-4552-7704.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Toymaker
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it due to Blossoming Tortoise, creating a 2/2 Spawn artifact creature token.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability by sacrificing the Spawn, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

2173-2469-5220-6634.description:
Cast Phyrexian Dreadnought from the top of your library by paying 1 life.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought enters, it triggers, causing you to sacrifice it.
When Phyrexian Dreadnought dies, Mortuary and Al Bhed Salvagers trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Phyrexian Dreadnought from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Al Bhed Salvagers trigger, causing you to gain 1 life and target opponent to lose 1 life.
Repeat.

719-2921-4302.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
719-2921-4302.description:
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Bishop of Wings' second ability triggers, creating a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
When the Spirit token enters the battlefield as an Angel due to Xenograft, Bishop of Wings' first ability triggers, causing you to gain 4 life.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

3277-5195-7431.description:
Cast Daydream by paying {W}, targeting Izzet Chronarch
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating a Treasure artifact token.
Resolve Daydream, blinking Izzet Chronarch
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Daydream to your hand from your graveyard.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Repeat.

1884-2060-3525-6996.easyPrerequisites:
Silent Attendant does not have summoning sickness.
Pemmin's Aura attached to Silent Attendant.
1884-2060-3525-6996.description:
Activate Silent Attendant by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Crystalline Crawler.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Pemmin's Aura's ability by paying {U}, untapping Silent Attendant.
Repeat.

uses.exileCardState: with three or fewer time counters on it

80-1298-1618-2440.description:
Activate The Tenth Doctor by paying {7}, removing all time counters from Venture Forth.
Venture Forth triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Ovika triggers, creating a number of creature tokens.
When the creature tokens enter, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each creature you control that shares a creature type with the token for each trigger.
Resolve Venture Forth.
Repeat.

2921-4605-6132-7261.description:
Cast Chord of Calling by paying at most {6}{G}{G}{G}, searching your library for Metamorphosis Fanatic and putting it onto the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it and Preston trigger.
Resolve the Metamorphosis Fanatic trigger, returning an applicable target from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Resolve the Preston trigger, creating a token copy of Metamorphosis Fanatic that is a 0/1 Illusion.
When the Metamorphosis Fanatic token enters, it triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3169-4019-6972.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to kill Vigean Graftmage.
3169-4019-6972.description:
Kill Vigean Graftmage.
When Vigean Graftmage dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its graft ability.
When Vigean Graftmage enters, Genesis Chamber triggers, creating a creature token.
When the creature token enters, Vigean Graftmage triggers, moving a +1/+1 counter from it to the creature token. Vigean Graftmage dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness.
Repeat from step 2.

630-1753-2366-5702.easyPrerequisites:
You have a land card in hand.
You are able to play a land this turn.
630-1753-2366-5702.description:
Play a land. When the land enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
When the Dryad Arbor token enters, Springheart Nantuko triggers. Holding priority, activate the Dryad Arbor token by tapping it, adding {G}.
Keeper of Progenitus triggers, adding {G}.
Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.n: Matzalantli, the Great Door // The Core

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to Ley Weaver with "Elf" chosen

1399-1606-6071-7040.notablePrerequisites: You have at least two permanent cards in your graveyard.
1399-1606-6071-7040.description:
Activate The Core by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and The Core.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

147-2292-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2292-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2292-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

2034-5220-5651.easyPrerequisites: You control another nontoken creature that can be cast using {C}{C} or less.
2034-5220-5651.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the nontoken creature, adding {C}{C}.
When the creature dies, Mortuary triggers, putting the creature from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Cast the creature by paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and with a +1/+1 counter on it

460-539-3990.description:
Activate Incubation Druid by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Scryb Ranger by returning it from the battlefield to your hand, untapping Incubation Druid.
Cast Scryb Ranger by paying {1}{G}.
Repeat.

193-290-3604.description:
Cast Aminatou by paying {W}{U}{B}.
When Aminatou enters the battlefield, Cadric triggers.
Holding priority, activate Dreamstone Hedron by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Resolve the Cadric trigger, causing you to pay {1} to create a token copy of Aminatou.
Activate Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking Dreamstone Hedron.
Activate the token Aminatou's second loyalty ability by removing a loyalty counter from it, blinking the nontoken Aminatou.
Repeat from step 2.
193-290-3604.notes: Once you have infinite mana, you can blink other permanent(s) instead. If those permanents are legendary, you can copy them via Cadric.

880-3470-6528.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Lotus Cobra and Elfsworn Giant trigger.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Elfsworn Giant trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

2105-3204-4359-6188.notablePrerequisites:
Fear of Missing Out cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
Mysterious Limousine does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked and killed by an opponent.
One of Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant must be on the battlefield, with the other exiled by Mysterious Limousine.
2105-3204-4359-6188.description:
Declare either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant and Mysterious Limousine as attackers.
Mysterious Limousine and either Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger.
Resolve the Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant trigger, untapping Mysterious Limousine and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Resolve the Mysterious Limousine trigger, exiling Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from the battlefield, and then returning Fear of Missing Out or Combat Celebrant from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat each combat phase.

1486-1719-1753-4452.notablePrerequisites: Rukarumel on the battlefield with "Dwarf" chosen.
1486-1719-1753-4452.description:
Activate Vizier of Tumbling Sands by tapping it, targeting Samut.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Vizier of Tumbling Sands ability, untapping Samut.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {W}.
Activate Samut by paying {W} and tapping it, targeting Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Magda triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Samut trigger, untapping Vizier of Tumbling Sands.
Repeat.
1486-1719-1753-4452.notes: Once you have infinite Treasures, you may use them to activate Magda's ability.

5173-5553-5626-5687.notablePrerequisites: One of Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast must be on the battlefield with the other in your graveyard.
5173-5553-5626-5687.description:
Cast Chthonian Nightmare by paying {1}{B}.
When Chthonian Nightmare enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing you to get {E}{E}{E}.
Activate Chthonian Nightmare by paying an amount of {E}, sacrificing Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast and returning Chthonian Nightmare from the battlefield to your hand.
When Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast dies, it and Skittering Precursor trigger.
Resolve the Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast trigger, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Skittering Precursor trigger, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
Resolve the Chthonian Nightmare ability, returning either Greedy Freebooter or Shambling Ghast from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

2691-3812-5963.notablePrerequisites:
You control a creature with power 4 or greater.
Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
2691-3812-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Ilysian Caryatid's ability by tapping it, adding {U}{U}.
Activate Marvin using Simic Ragworm's ability by paying {U}, untapping it.
Repeat.

1778-2538-3139-3676.description:
Cast Memnite by paying {0}.
Tangleroot triggers, adding {G}.
When Memnite enters the battlefield, The Great Henge triggers.
Holding priority, activate Words of Wind by paying {1}, replacing the next card you draw.
Resolve the The Great Henge trigger, causing you to return Memnite from the battlefield to your hand, and causing each opponent to return a permanent they control from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

372-2955-4477.notablePrerequisites: You have any number of other nonland permanents that enter the battlefield untapped, and that can collectively tap to produce enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal exiled by Abdel Adrian.
372-2955-4477.description:
Cast Justiciar's Portal by paying its mana cost, blinking Abdel Adrian.
Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, returning Greenwarden of Murasa and all other cards that were exiled with it to the battlefield.
Abdel Adrian and Greenwarden of Murasa trigger.
Resolve the Greenwarden of Murasa trigger, returning Justiciar's Portal from your graveyard to your hand.
Holding priority, activate any number of nonland permanents you control by tapping them, adding at least enough mana to cast Justiciar's Portal.
Resolve the Abdel Adrian trigger, exiling Greenwarden of Murasa and the mana-producing permanents until Abdel Adrian leaves the battlefield, and creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token for each permanent exiled this way.
Repeat.

950-2681-5881-5885.manaNeeded: {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, plus an additional {2}{G} if you don't control a commander
950-2681-5881-5885.notablePrerequisites: Anzrag and Fatestitcher do not have summoning sickness.
950-2681-5881-5885.description:
Activate Anzrag by paying {3}{R}{R}{G}{G}, causing opponents to block Anzrag if able this turn.
Cast Obscuring Haze by paying {0} if you control a commander, or {2}{G} otherwise, preventing all combat damage that would be dealt by opposing creatures this turn.
Declare Anzrag as an attacker, attacking any opponent.
If the opponent does not control a creature, activate Forbidden Orchard by tapping it, adding one mana of any color.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, it triggers, causing the defending opponent to create a 1/1 Spirit creature token.
If Forbidden Orchard was activated, activate Fatestitcher by tapping it, untapping Forbidden Orchard.
The opponent is forced to block Anzrag, triggering Anzrag, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Any combat damage that would be dealt to Anzrag is prevented by Obscuring Haze.
Repeat from step 3 each combat phase.

1367-3039-4450-4493.description:
Cast Irenicus's Vile Duplication by paying {3}{U}, creating a nonlegendary copy of Carth the Lion with flying.
Cast Nexus of Fate by paying {5}{U}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one and shuffle Nexus of Fate into your library.
Activate Liliana Vess's second loyalty ability by removing zero loyalty counters from it, searching your library for Nexus of Fate, then shuffling your library and putting it on top.
Move to your next turn, drawing Nexus of Fate during your draw step.
Repeat from step 2.

2011-3073-4076.notablePrerequisites:
You have at least three creatures in your party.
Burakos does not have summoning sickness.
An opponent is unable to block and kill Burakos.
2011-3073-4076.description:
Declare Burakos as an attacker.
Najeela and Burakos trigger twice.
Resolve both Najeela triggers, creating two 1/1 Warrior creature tokens that are tapped and attacking.
Resolve the Burakos triggers, creating at least six Treasure artifact tokens and causing the defending opponent to lose at least 6 life.
Activate five Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}.
Activate Najeela by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, untapping all attacking creatures, giving them trample, lifelink and haste, and gaining an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

224-1359-2034-2366-5220.notablePrerequisites: You are abile to play a land this turn.
224-1359-2034-2366-5220.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters the battlefield, Retreat to Coralhelm triggers.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Dryad Arbor, adding {C}{C}.
When Dryad Arbor dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Dryad Arbor on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Retreat to Coralhelm trigger from step 2, causing you to scry 1, ensuring to leave Dryad Arbor on top of your library.
Galadriel's second ability triggers, causing you to reveal Dryad Arbor from the top of your library, and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
Repeat from step 2.

1604-4684.notablePrerequisites: Ith does not have summoning sickness.
1604-4684.description:
Declare Ith as an attacker.
Activate Ith by tapping it, untapping Ith and preventing all combat damage that would be dealt to or dealt by it this turn.
Mesmeric Orb triggers, causing you to mill a card.
Repeat from step 2.

431-2557-3129-4772.notablePrerequisites: You control at least seven untapped Merfolk.
431-2557-3129-4772.description:
Whenever an opponent casts a spell, activate Lullmage Mentor by tapping seven untapped Merfolk, countering that spell.
Lullmage Mentor triggers, creating a total of eight 1/1 Merfolk creature tokens.
Repeat.
